script.title: తులసి కళ్యాణంలో వరుడు ఉసిరి కొమ్మ ఎందుకు?
sentences: క్షీరాబ్ధి ద్వాదశి నాడు తెలుగు లోగిళ్లలో ఓ పెళ్లి జరుగుతుంది.
పురాణ కథ ప్రకారం, విష్ణుభక్తురాలు వృందను వచ్చే జన్మలో పెళ్లాడతానని శ్రీమహావిష్ణువు వరమిచ్చారు.
ఆ వృందే తులసిగా భూమిపై పుట్టిందని ఓ కథ చెబుతుంది.
తులసి కోటలో ఒక ఉసిరి కొమ్మ పెడతారు, తెలుగువారు ఆ కొమ్మనే విష్ణువుగా పూజిస్తారు.
మీ ఇంట్లో తులసమ్మ పక్కన ఉసిరి కొమ్మా, సాలగ్రామమా?
scenes: Extreme close-up of a Telugu woman's joyful face in a silk sari and turmeric on her cheeks, offering a lamp to a decorated tulasi plant at dusk, warm diya glow.
A tulasi plant in a decorated tulasi kota in a Telugu household courtyard, rangoli on the floor, lamps glowing, evening light, medium shot.
A tulasi plant decorated like a bride with tiny jewellery, flower garlands and a red cloth, Telugu women smiling as they adorn it, warm lamplight, close medium shot.
Vishnu with blue skin and four arms blessing the devoted Vrinda, a young woman with folded hands and tearful eyes, celestial light, medium shot.
Vrinda transforming into a tulasi plant, divine glow and leaves sprouting around her, Vishnu watching lovingly, ethereal soft light, wide shot.
A puzzled Telugu child in festive clothes looking around the courtyard during the tulasi wedding, asking her grandmother something, lamps glowing, medium shot.
A Telugu family placing an amla branch beside the tulasi plant in its kota and offering prayers, lamps and flowers, Vishnu's presence suggested by a faint glow, medium shot.
A tulasi plant and an amla branch together in a decorated tulasi kota, lamps and flowers around, Telugu household at dusk, warm glow, close-up.
script.description:
తులసి కళ్యాణంలో వరుడు ఎవరు?
క్షీరాబ్ధి ద్వాదశి నాడు తులసమ్మ పెళ్లి వెనుక కథ.
claims_en: Among Telugus, Tulasi Kalyanam is mainly celebrated on Kartika Shukla Dvadashi, also called Utthana or Ksheerabdhi Dwadashi
The bride is the tulasi plant, traditionally planted in the courtyard of Hindu houses
Tulasi is decorated like a bride, complete with jewellery
Legend / popular tradition: Vrinda was a pious devotee of Vishnu, and Vishnu gave a blessing to marry Vrinda in her next birth
In a variation of the legend, Vishnu ensures that Vrinda is incarnated as the tulasi plant on earth
Among Telugus a branch of the amla tree is placed in the Tulasi Vrindavan and Vishnu is worshipped in the form of the amla plant
Elsewhere the groom is more frequently the shaligrama stone, the symbol of Vishnu
